title: sgv2 differential rig trace line (one JSON object per rendered slice)
description: Both sides write one line per host slice. compare.py matches lines whose slices end on the same input frame (frame + frames). Fields a side cannot observe are omitted or null; null is never zero.

case.description: case identifier from the rig's case list

frame.description: index of the slice's first input frame

latency.description: the unit's reported latency in frames

params.description: sgv2: where the unit's parameters came from (blob, none, blob-<error>)

cfprops.description: sgv2: IDs of the run-time and case properties the renderer was given, in order; must equal the reference's resolved list (run.meta.json cfprops)

health.description: sgv2: Health bits after the slice

failsafe.description: fail-safe attenuation applied in this slice; macOS side: measured from the audio (gain 0.1 on every channel)

gain.description: final linear gain the unit reports for this slice

audio_gain.description: broadband gain measured from the audio: sqrt(energy out / energy in), aligned by latency; null below -120 dBFS input

axis_gain.description: linear: sample peak, displacement, velocity, power, temperature

raw.description: unit-private state not yet named by the specification; not compared
